items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがCold Jet, LLC(Miami Township)に対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を8年間・1.567%の税率で承認。新規雇用67人・新規年間給与$5,025,000のコミットメントに基づく。

items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.567% for 8 years on 2022-08-29 for a project in Miami Township, Clermont County. Commitment: create 67 full-time equivalent employees generating $5,025,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
